entities.name: India Dowry Prohibition Act
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: India banned dowry demands in 1961 after a surge in "dowry deaths" — brides murdered or driven to suicide when their families couldn't pay. Despite the ban, dowry remains widespread: an estimated $130 billion in dowries are exchanged annually in India. Enforcement remains weak.
